name: Peking Man Site at Zhoukoudian
description: In limestone hills about 42 km south-west of Beijing, the Zhoukoudian cave system is where one of the first known Homo erectus fossils, "Peking Man," came to light. Digs since the 1920s have uncovered the remains of about 45 individuals, plus stone tools and animal bones, from several hundred thousand years ago. Modern human remains from the Upper Cave show that people returned here much later.
